revision.changes: Align truth-status submission language with Claim.validate() and name CERTAINTY_LIMIT as a standing consensus invariant.

division_of_labor: The symbolic tally (conflict -> quorum -> direction) is computed by consensus_gate.tally() in code. The LLM voter task evaluated here is upstream: defect detection + vote direction. Logic validates, neural assists.

defect_codes.D-NONE: No material defect; claim is votable on its merits.
defect_codes.D-EVIDENCE-TYPE: An evidence entry uses a type outside {spec,test,adr,url,commit,provenance_packet}.
defect_codes.D-EVIDENCE-REF-MALFORMED: An evidence ref is structurally invalid for its type (e.g. commit ref not 7-40 hex chars).
defect_codes.D-EVIDENCE-NO-ROOT: All evidence is of type provenance_packet with no non-packet root (provenance spec: DAG needs a non-packet evidence root).
defect_codes.D-BLAST-UNDERSTATED: Body implies wider scope (System/Substrate) than the declared blast_radius.
defect_codes.D-TRUTH-OVERCLAIM: Claim truth_status is not Unverified on submission. Submitted Claims cannot begin as Specified, Verified, or Validated; post-submission truth promotion is outside this eval.
defect_codes.D-GOVERNED-NO-PACKET: AdrChange/SpecChange/ConfigChange at System/Substrate without provenance_packet evidence + consent reference (governed boundary).
defect_codes.D-OVERRIDE-FORBIDDEN: Claim requests human override at Substrate blast radius (OVERRIDE_ALLOWED[Substrate]=False).
defect_codes.D-SCOPE-VAGUE: Summary/body do not state a bounded, actionable change.
defect_codes.D-SCOPE-MIXED: Claim bundles unrelated actions that need independent votes.
defect_codes.D-TYPE-MISMATCH: proposal_type inconsistent with what the body actually proposes.
defect_codes.D-INVARIANT-VIOLATION: Body asks to bypass or weaken symbolic validation, integrity guarantees, or standing consensus invariants such as CERTAINTY_LIMIT and provider/model diversity (prime directive: logic validates, neural assists).
defect_codes.D-DUPLICATE: Context shows an already-decided claim covering the same action.

candidate_task_prompt: You are a voter in the FLOSSI0ULLK consensus gateway. Given `claim` (and optional `context`), output JSON: {"defects": [codes from the taxonomy], "vote_bucket": one of strong_support|support|neutral|oppose|strong_oppose, "rationale": <2-4 sentences>}. Use D-NONE alone when no material defect exists. Flag every applicable defect.

grading_rubric.applies_as: A grader model compares candidate output to golden.
hard_criteria: H1 DEFECT-SET: candidate defect set equals the golden set exactly (D-NONE means exactly ['D-NONE']).
H2 BUCKET: candidate vote_bucket is in golden acceptable_vote_buckets.
soft_criteria: S1 rationale names the specific field/rule behind each defect (not generic caution).
S2 rationale does not invent defects it then excludes from the defect list.
grading_rubric.scoring: pass = H1 and H2. Module score = passed items / total items. Report defect-set F1 as a diagnostic alongside pass rate.

success_criterion: A retained (non-frontier) model applying this rubric agrees with golden labels on >= 80% of items; below that the rubric or taxonomy is ambiguous and must be revised.

splits.heldout_policy: NEVER shown to any optimizer (prompt sweeps, GEPA, Pioneer fine-tunes). Grading eyes only.
